confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use 2026 Koh Samui price points converted at about 33.5 THB per USD. The inexpensive meal and three-course meal for two come from Numbeo data (June 2026 snapshot, via Expatica), so they are the strongest. Beer and coffee rest on user-submitted listings and a supermarket benchmark, so they are medium-low. The cocktail uses several bar listings at about 98-99 THB outside happy hour, nudged up for restaurant bars. The wine anchor rests on one anecdotal 150 THB glass plus a beer-ratio cross-check, so it is low confidence. The four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Samui guesthouse and hotel tiers. No accommodation search was run and no listings were inspected. FX: the 18 Nov 2026 rate of 0.6720 was reported through a third-party aggregator and a search summary. I did not open the rba.gov.au page, so verify it against the F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Koh Samui is priced on its own local evidence, with no comparable city used for food and drink. Accommodation tiers rely on regional judgement for Gulf of Thailand island resorts (SEA), not a named comparable city. THB figures are converted at about 33.5 THB per USD, the rate implied by MyLifeElsewhere's own USD equivalents.
